title: Relative pseudo-coherence is a two-of-three property on distinguished triangles, with the sharp m/m+1 bookkeeping
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For X -> S locally of finite type and a distinguished triangle (E, E', E'') in D(O_X), the lemma records three cone implications: E (m+1)-pseudo-coherent relative to S with E' m-pseudo-coherent forces E'' m-pseudo-coherent; E and E'' m-pseudo-coherent forces E' m-pseudo-coherent; E' (m+1)-pseudo-coherent with E'' m-pseudo-coherent forces E (m+1)-pseudo-coherent; moreover two-of-three full pseudo-coherence passes to the third. The retained proof is written: the chartwise characterization lemma relative-pseudo-coherence-characterize (registered by lane S9) translates all three clauses into the absolute cone statement Cohomology, lemma cone-pseudo-coherent, quoted by name, and the translation is immediate. Retained author proof at lines 17034-17037.
